snippet.title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon® Wildlands: Last Rites Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Return to a darker, more hostile Bolivia to hunt down a sinister new threat, La Llorona--a cult leader, in a tense and unsettling new linear mission.

Last Rites is a free update for Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Wildlands, celebrating the franchise’s 25th anniversary, featuring 4K and 60 FPS upgrades, expanded customization options, and more!

#Ubisoft #GhostRecon

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
